name: vitals-strip
description: Unraid and Home Assistant health above the prompt: array and pools, CPU and memory, containers (unhealthy, or stopped though set to autostart), unread Unraid alerts, parity runs, and HA state, repairs and notifications. Quiet by default: it shows only what isn't green. /vitals for the full strip.

unraidServer.title: Unraid MCP server
unraidServer.description: The unraid-mcp server's name as /mcp lists it. Read-only calls only.

haServer.title: Home Assistant MCP server
haServer.description: The HA-MCP connector's name as /mcp lists it, or its tool-name spelling (the part between mcp__ and __ha_). Empty leaves HA out.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to read health; 0 reads only on /vitals.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Show the band only when something isn't green.
